name: JA_CN_JOURNAL_LINES_REQ
description: This table contains temporarily the journal lines of the current session, which are itemized with information about related subsidiary accounts, if any

columns.name: JL_LINES_REQ_ID
columns.description: An identifier that uniquely identifies a journal line requisition.

columns.name: JE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: An identifier that uniquely identifies an accounting header.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: An identifier that uniquely identifies a legal entity.

columns.name: JE_LINE_NUM
columns.description: The number of journal entry line.

columns.name: JE_CATEGORY
columns.description: The category code of journal entry.

columns.name: DEFAULT_EFFECTIVE_DATE
columns.description: Date from when the journal entry will be active.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Accounting period for which the delta balances should be tracked.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code for the amounts in a record.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONVERSION_RATE
columns.description: Exchange rate type for transaction currency to functional currency conversion.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of the line after splitting.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the journal entry line.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Column that defines the key flex field combination.

columns.name: BALANCING_SEGMENT
columns.description: Value for balancing segment of accounting flex field.

columns.name: NATURAL_ACCOUNT_SEGMENT
columns.description: Value for natural account number of accounting flexfield.

columns.name: COST_CENTER_SEGMENT
columns.description: Value for cost center segment of accounting flexfield.

columns.name: PROJECT_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of the project.  When the project is defined as "Chart of Account", the value is project segment.

columns.name: PROJECT_ID
columns.description:
Identifier of the project from which the costs are 
collected, summarized, and transferred from Oracle Projects.

columns.name: THIRD_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Third party identifier, such as customer identifier and supplier identifier.

columns.name: THIRD_PARTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of third party, such as customer number and supplier number.

columns.name: PROJECT_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of the project. When the project is defined as 'Chart of Account', the value is 'COA'. When the project is defined as 'project module', the value is 'PA'.

columns.name: THIRD_PARTY_TYPE
columns.description: Source to indicate the type of third party. 'C' indicates customer and 'S' indicates supplier.

columns.name: PERSONNEL_ID
columns.description: An identifier that uniquely identifies a personnel.

columns.name: PERSONNEL_NUMBER
columns.description: The employee number for employee supplier.

columns.name: ENTERED_DR
columns.description: Debit amount on the journal entry line. The amount is specified in the entered currency.

columns.name: ENTERED_CR
columns.description: Credit amount on the journal entry line. The amount is specified in the entered currency.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_DR
columns.description: Debit amount on the journal entry line. The amount is specified in the base currency.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_CR
columns.description: Credit amount on the journal entry line. The amount is specified in the base currency.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Flag that indicates whether the current record is calculated into the balance table. Valid values are 'P' or 'U'.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOURNAL_APPROVER

columns.description: Name of the person who posted the journal.
